from typing import List


def all_prefixes(string: str) -> List[str]:
    
    result = []

    for i in range(len(string)):
        result.append(string[:i+1])
    return result



# Unit test for function all_prefixes
def test_all_prefixes():
    # Test with a simple string
    assert all_prefixes("abc") == ["a", "ab", "abc"]

    # Test with a single character string
    assert all_prefixes("a") == ["a"]

    # Test with an empty string
    assert all_prefixes("") == []

    # Test with a longer string
    assert all_prefixes("hello") == ["h", "he", "hel", "hell", "hello"]

    # Test with a string containing spaces
    assert all_prefixes("ab cd") == ["a", "ab", "ab ", "ab c", "ab cd"]

    # Test with numeric characters
    assert all_prefixes("123") == ["1", "12", "123"]

    # Test with special characters
    assert all_prefixes("!@#") == ["!", "!@", "!@#"]

    # Test result length matches string length
    assert len(all_prefixes("python")) == 6

    # Test last prefix equals the full string
    assert all_prefixes("test")[-1] == "test"

    # Test first prefix is a single character
    assert all_prefixes("test")[0] == "t"

    print("All tests passed!")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    test_all_prefixes()
